description: This file defines system call interfaces, macros, and related functions for the Zephyr RTOS, including syscall handling, verification, and context checking.

methods.name: z_syscall_trap
methods.description: Determines if the current syscall must trap to the kernel based on configuration and context.

methods.name: k_is_user_context
methods.description: Checks if the CPU is currently executing in user mode.
